name: manual_dc8f48
claim: Report tested, published, reviewed, CI-green, merged and production-promoted as distinct states tied to exact revisions.

decisions.notes: This saga included local unpublished fixes, historical green runs, merged-into-peer rather than main ADRs, a candidate-only overlay and pending skill-scanner. Conflating these states forced repeated status requests and could prematurely promote the runtime.
